the AC loss of a superconducting tape array is lower than that of an array of round wires, and that the AC loss can be further reduced by arranging the tape array in the form of a meandering structure.

the ac loss of an x-array of elliptical tapes carrying anti-parallel currents is higher than that of infinitely distant tapes, while a y-array of elliptical conductors has a lower ac loss than an array of round wires.
